title: Decimal byte units
rationale: Expands common decimal storage symbols and preserves singular and plural quantities.
originalText: The values are 1 B, 2 KB, 3 MB, 4 GB, and 5 TB.
expectedPreparedText: The values are 1 byte, 2 kilobytes, 3 megabytes, 4 gigabytes, and 5 terabytes.

title: Binary byte units
rationale: Uses approved candidate phonemes for the binary unit names that Kokoro mispronounces as plain text.
originalText: The values are 1 KiB, 2 MiB, 3 GiB, and 4 TiB.

title: Network and transfer rates
rationale: Distinguishes bits per second from bytes per second and removes spoken slash characters.
originalText: The link reaches 100 Mbps and 10 Gbps, while the disk reaches 500 MB/s and 5 GB/s.
expectedPreparedText: The link reaches 100 megabits per second and 10 gigabits per second, while the disk reaches 500 megabytes per second and 5 gigabytes per second.

title: Metric length
rationale: Expands common metric length symbols in numeric measurements.
originalText: The measurements are 1 mm, 20 cm, 2 m, and 5 km.
expectedPreparedText: The measurements are 1 millimetre, 20 centimetres, 2 metres, and 5 kilometres.

title: Imperial length
rationale: Handles regular and irregular singular forms for inches and feet.
originalText: The measurements are 1 in, 12 in, 1 ft, and 6 ft.
expectedPreparedText: The measurements are 1 inch, 12 inches, 1 foot, and 6 feet.

title: Mass units
rationale: Expands common metric and imperial mass symbols while leaving the already-correct lbs form alone.
originalText: The values are 1 mg, 500 g, 1 kg, 2 oz, 1 lb, and 2 lbs.
expectedPreparedText: The values are 1 milligram, 500 grams, 1 kilogram, 2 ounces, 1 pound, and 2 lbs.

title: Volume units
rationale: Supports the standard mL spelling, its common lowercase variant, and litres.
originalText: The values are 1 mL, 250 ml, 1 L, and 2 L.
expectedPreparedText: The values are 1 millilitre, 250 millilitres, 1 litre, and 2 litres.

title: Time units
rationale: Expands common subsecond, second, minute, and hour symbols only after numeric quantities.
originalText: Wait 1 ns, 2 µs, 3 μs, 4 us, 5 ms, 1 s, 10 min, 1 h, and 2 hr.
expectedPreparedText: Wait 1 nanosecond, 2 microseconds, 3 microseconds, 4 microseconds, 5 milliseconds, 1 second, 10 minutes, 1 hour, and 2 hours.

title: Frequency units
rationale: Expands hertz units without pluralising the word hertz.
originalText: The values are 1 Hz, 2 kHz, 500 MHz, and 4 GHz.
expectedPreparedText: The values are 1 hertz, 2 kilohertz, 500 megahertz, and 4 gigahertz.

title: Voltage and current
rationale: Expands volts and amps while respecting milli-prefix casing.
originalText: The values are 1 mV, 12 V, 1 mA, and 2 A.
expectedPreparedText: The values are 1 millivolt, 12 volts, 1 milliamp, and 2 amps.

title: Power and energy
rationale: Expands watts, kilowatts, watt-hours, and kilowatt-hours.
originalText: The values are 1 W, 2 kW, 1 Wh, and 80 kWh.
expectedPreparedText: The values are 1 watt, 2 kilowatts, 1 watt-hour, and 80 kilowatt-hours.

title: Speed units
rationale: Expands slash rates and miles per hour without reading punctuation aloud.
originalText: The values are 1 m/s, 5 m/s, 1 km/h, 50 km/h, 1 mph, and 30 mph.
expectedPreparedText: The values are 1 metre per second, 5 metres per second, 1 kilometre per hour, 50 kilometres per hour, 1 mile per hour, and 30 miles per hour.

title: Temperature units
rationale: Expands degree symbols to Celsius and Fahrenheit with singular and plural quantities.
expectedPreparedText: The values are 1 degree Celsius, 20 degrees Celsius, 1 degree Fahrenheit, and 70 degrees Fahrenheit.

title: Scoped name titles
rationale: Adds the working punctuation for Ms and expands the titles Kokoro otherwise spells out.
originalText: Ms Smith, Prof. Daniel Jones, Rev. Anna Brown, and Mx. Taylor Smith approved the report.
expectedPreparedText: Ms. Smith, Professor Daniel Jones, Reverend Anna Brown, and Mix Taylor Smith approved the report.

title: Measurements used before nouns
rationale: Uses the singular unit name in determiner-led modifier phrases without changing ordinary measured quantities.
originalText: Copy the 4 GB file after a 5 ms delay using this 12 V adapter.
expectedPreparedText: Copy the 4 gigabyte file after a 5 millisecond delay using this 12 volt adapter.

title: Modifier and measured quantity together
rationale: Distinguishes a unit modifying a noun from the same unit describing a measured value.
originalText: Use a 20 cm cable, but confirm that it is 20 cm long.
expectedPreparedText: Use a 20 centimetre cable, but confirm that it is 20 centimetres long.

title: Decimal quantities
rationale: Keeps fractional quantities plural while treating a numeric value equal to one as singular.
originalText: The images occupy 0.5 GB and 1.0 GB.
expectedPreparedText: The images occupy 0.5 gigabytes and 1.0 gigabyte.

title: Thousands separators and compact rates
rationale: Removes spoken thousands separators that Kokoro treats as number breaks, and expands compact transfer-rate forms.
originalText: The cache uses 1,024 MB and streams at 500MB/s.
expectedPreparedText: The cache uses one thousand and twenty-four megabytes and streams at 500 megabytes per second.

title: Ambiguous text remains unchanged
rationale: Proves that non-numeric unit symbols, MOD, and the already-correct lbs form are not rewritten while the approved Ms title refinement still applies.
originalText: Ms Smith discussed GB and cm, installed the MOD, and moved 2 lbs.
expectedPreparedText: Ms. Smith discussed GB and cm, installed the MOD, and moved 2 lbs.
